name: Health and Maternity Cover for the Construction Workers
nodalDept: Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD
targetBeneficiaries: Eligible women members of the BOCW Welfare Board
briefDescription: The "Health and Maternity Cover for the Construction Workers" scheme offers financial assistance for maternity to eligible registered women members of the BOCW Welfare Board, DNH & DD.
descriptionMd: The Health and Maternity Cover for the Construction Workers is a vital welfare initiative. It is provided by the BOCW Welfare Board under the Labour Department of the U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. The scheme aims to support the health and well-being of women construction workers by offering financial aid during maternity.
eligibilityMd:
- Applicant must be a registered woman member of the BOCW Welfare Board.
- The applicant must meet the eligibility criteria as defined by the board.
- Scheme is exclusively for women construction workers.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
